label: Comparison top 100
method: Synthetic inputs: 1,000 accounts with 100 future departures. Each selected list contains 100 accounts; lists containing 20 and 40 departures have precision of 20% and 40%, respectively. Recall is also 20% and 40% because there are 100 total departures. Identification does not establish prevented churn or causal retention uplift.
